name: Wealthfolio
description: Wealthfolio is an open source investment portfolio tracker for monitoring holdings, accounts, performance, and market activity from your own server. It is designed for private wealth tracking, with a browser-based dashboard and local SQLite storage for portfolio data.
author: Wealthfolio
